title: On Recommending the younger man for the post
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：recommend　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 recommend 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the musician ① recommended the younger man for the post in silence, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the musician ② recommends the younger man for the post twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ recommend the younger man for the post at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ recommended the younger man for the post before — a line in the programme for December 1956 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Recommending the younger man for the post in silence, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ recommend waiting another whole spring twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Recommend waiting another whole spring at once and never mention it again.

By 1969 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new listener from the next hall ⑧ recommends waiting another whole spring in silence every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the piano, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ recommended the younger man for the post again when nobody else would.

⑩ To recommend the younger man for the post, my mother said in 1974, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the hall remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the hall forgets, somebody recommends the younger man for the post twice over again and somebody must recommend the younger man for the post in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 推荐（一般过去式 recommended the younger man for the post：1962 年乐师头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 推荐（一般现在 recommends the younger man for the post：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 推荐（不定式 to recommend the younger man for the post：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 推荐（过去完成时 had recommended the younger man for the post：1956 年十二月的节目单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 推荐（动名词 recommending the younger man for the post 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 建议（recommend waiting another whole spring：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去建议建议再等上整整一个春天）
G. v. 建议（recommend waiting another whole spring：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 推荐（后段两处：新来的听客照例 recommends waiting another whole spring，而母亲又一次 recommended the younger man for the post）

recommend 意为“推荐”，自那以后乐师来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 recommends。
recommend 意为“推荐”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯推荐推荐那位年轻人接这个职位”，此处为不定式 to recommend the younger man for the post。
recommend 意为“推荐”，节目单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1969 年之前就有人推荐过，故用过去完成时 had recommended。
recommend 意为“推荐”，乐师说“推荐推荐那位年轻人接这个职位这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 recommending the younger man for the post 作主语。
recommend 意为“建议”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去建议建议再等上整整一个春天”，should ever 之后用原形 recommend waiting another whole spring。
recommend 意为“建议”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻建议建议再等上整整一个春天（recommend waiting another whole spring at once），以后再也不要提起。
recommend 意为“推荐”，新来的听客每个夜晚都照例建议建议再等上整整一个春天，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 recommends。
recommend 意为“推荐”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地推荐推荐那位年轻人接这个职位，用一般过去式 recommended 叙述。
recommend 意为“推荐”，结尾那句是母亲 1974 年的话：要推荐推荐那位年轻人接这个职位，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和音乐厅记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 recommend 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the musician recommended the younger man for the post in silence, and nobody in the hall forgot it.
Even now the musician recommends the younger man for the post twice over whenever the hall asks.
Recommending the younger man for the post in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever recommend waiting another whole spring twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next hall recommends waiting another whole spring in silence every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother recommended the younger man for the post again, and the hall remembered that half.
